title: Data and R code for: Haunted by the light: Effects of street lighting on the green ghost firefly
description: Data and R code supporting the manuscript "Haunted by the light: Effects of street lighting on the green ghost firefly Lamprohiza splendidula L.". The repository contains datasets and R analyses for field experiments examining the effects of artificial light at night on courtship-related male activity of the green ghost firefly, Lamprohiza splendidula. The experiments include the 2023 illuminance experiment under high-pressure sodium lighting, the 2024 comparison of high-pressure sodium and warm LED lighting, and the 2025 experimental introduction and removal of biodynamic lighting in PC-Amber mode. Funding: Technology Agency of the Czech Republic, grant SS06010373.
